name: DICKINSON ARMS COMMANDO
description: The Dickinson Commando delivers a lightweight, durable, and reliable pump-action shotgun design with good versatility. It comes chambered in 12 GAUGE with a 3" chamber and an 18.5" barrel. Features include ghost ring sights, Picatinny rails, and a 4 round capacity.

name: DICKINSON ARMS COMMANDO 12
description: The Dickinson Arms Commando 12 is a semi-automatic shotgun designed to be rugged and dependable. It is an excellent candidate for home-defense as well as fun at the range, all while being within the budget of most shooters. The synthetic furniture as well as the matte black heavy duty paint job ensure this firearm will be corrosion resistant.

name: DICKINSON ARMS RNG SURVIVAL
description: The RNG (Ranger) series features a simple and robust single-shot break-action design aimed at creating a lightweight hunting shotgun. Weight and balance has been optimized to ensure comfortable hunting all day long. The Survival model is specialized for emergency, featuring a weatherproof synthetic stock and a fixed full choke to create a tight spread when firing. The barrel is shortened to 18.5 inches to allow for storage in compact spaces such as vehicles. This model is chambered in .410 Gauge and features a 18.5-inch barrel and 2.75-inch chamber.

The barrel, fore-end, and bolt are easily removed as a unit for easy cleaning.
